description: This file defines classes and prototypes for managing context menus and menu models, including adding items, separators, initializing menu structures, and handling user interactions such as displaying and hiding menus.

classes.name: DHTMLGoodies_menuModel
classes.description: Class for organizing menu items, adding items and separators, initializing menu structure, and managing menu item depths.

classes.name: DHTMLGoodies_contextMenu
classes.description: Class for creating, attaching, and managing context menus, including event handling for display, hide, and user interaction effects.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds a menu item with specified properties such as id, text, icon, URL, parent id, and JavaScript function.

methods.name: addSeparator
methods.description: Adds a separator element to the menu with specified id and parent id.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the menu model, computing depths of menu items.

methods.name: getItems
methods.description: Returns the array of menu items.

methods.name: __getDepths
methods.description: Calculates and assigns depth levels to menu items based on parent-child relationships.

methods.name: __hasSubs
methods.description: Checks if a menu item has sub-elements.

methods.name: setWidth
methods.description: Sets the width of the context menu.

methods.name: setLayoutCss
methods.description: Sets the CSS file for menu layout.

methods.name: attachToElement
methods.description: Attaches the context menu to a specified HTML element, setting up event handlers.

methods.name: __setReference
methods.description: Creates a reference to the current context menu object (deprecated approach).

methods.name: __displayContextMenu
methods.description: Displays the context menu at the event location, creating menu items dynamically.

methods.name: __createDivs
methods.description: Creates the main div container for the context menu.

methods.name: __mouseOver
methods.description: Handles mouse over effect on menu items.

methods.name: __mouseOut
methods.description: Removes mouse over effect from menu items.

methods.name: __evalUrl
methods.description: Evaluates and executes the JavaScript function associated with a menu item.

methods.name: __createMenuItems
methods.description: Creates the menu item elements within the context menu based on menu data.

methods.name: getSrcElement
methods.description: Returns the DOM element that triggered an event.
